newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Lyonnais off on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais off on profit-taking.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais investment certificates were sharply lower as investors took profits after a rise over the last two weeks, dealers said.
The certificates were off 5.50 francs or 3.74 percent at 141.50 francs in very light volume.
"The stock has performed quite well in the last two weeks and there is some profit-taking," a trader said.
"Without volume, the stock is going down a bit, but there is no news on the stock," he added.
The investment certificates in the state-controlled bank make up about a fifth of its capital but carry no voting rights and are generally considered a speculative play.
